An indirect device invocation is defined as a call through a pointer that refers to the host version of the procedure. Here f is assigned inside the target region from tw and th, which are in declare target, so f refers to the device versions and the call is an ordinary device call. The indirect clause rules do not apply. No restriction is violated, and base-language semantics give the expected result.
